agentStop.bash: if command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmux notify --title "Copilot CLI" --subtitle "Waiting" --body "Ready for your input"; fi

notification.bash: if command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmux notify --title "Copilot CLI" --subtitle "Action needed" --body "Copilot needs your input"; fi

errorOccurred.bash: if command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmux notify --title "Copilot CLI" --subtitle "Error" --body "An error occurred"; fi
